turns.doctor_question: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi. It's nice to meet you too. 

Well, I'm here because I just... I can't stop seeing this droop and unevenness around my mouth and jaw. It's all I see in every photo and every time I look in a reflection. People keep telling me I look fine, but it feels so incredibly obvious to me. turns.doctor_question: Do you find yourself repeatedly checking your mouth or jaw in mirrors, photos, or other reflections?
